summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the conditional life-and-death assertions, uncertainty about heartfelt denial, impossibility of salvation for present intended denial, qualified availability of repentance for past deniers, and urgency before the tower’s completion. Reader-facing servant and contextual repentance terminology follow current policy. The supplement and mountain-variant notes accurately disclose the supplied apparatus reports without treating editorial supplementation as preserved manuscript wording or claiming fresh witness verification. Acceptance is limited to this supplied text and evidence; it is not manuscript authentication, exhaustive collation, or scholarly certification.
